semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily provides fittings, clean tubes, and personnel placement services, which are not core to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SATAKE Precision Technology specializes in the manufacturing of seamless stainless steel clean tubes and fittings, as well as providing fluid piping components and personnel placement services. Their products are designed for cleanroom environments, supporting industries that require high purity standards.
capabilities: Seamless stainless steel clean tubes available in multiple sizes
Fluid piping components including piping manifolds and block manifolds
Welding and assembly work in cleanroom environments
Personnel placement services for skilled factory workers and CAD/CAM operators

regional_presence.Japan: The company has manufacturing facilities in Yamagata Prefecture and a trading company in Saitama Prefecture.
